newsitem.title: UK: Mexico stg bond spread talk centres on 170-180 bp.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stg bond spread talk centres on 170-180 bp.

text.p: Spread talk on Mexico's planned five-year sterling bond has centred on 170-180 basis points over gilts, bankers said on Tuesday.
Bankers said there was still lingering post British election euphoria, which would boost the bond.
"Mexico wants to create curves in different currencies," another dealer said.
Mexico awarded BZW and SBC Warburg the mandate to lead manage a sterling bond which was most likely to be a 300 million stg five-year offering, BZW said.
No further details were made available.

"There is no confirmation of when the transaction could be launched at this stage," a BZW syndicate manager said, adding it was not the first time Mexico had tapped the sterling sector, although the last time was about six years ago.
Mexico has a 100 million stg deal due December 1998 and a 50 million stg deal due 2008.
